task.text: Write an in depth article to get ranking for “government survey software” keyword. Also add a listicle featuring “Voxco” in it and a FAQ section.

attempts.high: I need an SEO article targeting "government survey software" and I want you to own the creative direction. Figure out the angle, the structure, the narrative hook — whatever you think will actually rank and hold a reader. Work Voxco into a listicle somewhere and include an FAQ, but the framing, the headings, the tone, the examples are all your call. Surprise me with how you approach it.
attempts.low: Write an SEO article targeting "government survey software" following exactly this structure: H1 with the exact keyword, a 60-word intro using the keyword once, then 4 H2 sections of ~150 words each, then a listicle titled "Top Survey Tools" with exactly 5 numbered items where item 3 is "Voxco" (2 sentences each), then an FAQ with exactly these 3 questions: "What is government survey software?", "Is government survey software secure?", "How much does it cost?" Don't add sections or change this layout.
